question: According to the SSC Junior Engineer Examination 2026 notice, what is the scheme of Paper-I for a JE (Electrical) candidate?
solution: The notice (para 13) gives Paper-I: General Intelligence and Reasoning 50/50, General Awareness 50/50, plus Part-B General Engineering (Electrical) 100/100 - i.e. 200 questions / 200 marks in 2 hours - and states Paper-I is qualifying in nature, shortlisting candidates for Paper-II. Source checked: https://ssc.gov.in/api/attachment/uploads/masterData/NoticeBoards/Notice_of_adv_je_2026.pdf
